<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/account/{account}/message"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Upload a message structure, compile it into an EML file and store it into selected mailbox.<br/><br/>For MS Graph accounts only drafts can be uploaded, and the draft flag cannot be changed afterwards.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
>
</Heading>
